attempts.sql: WITH RECURSIVE chain(caller_symbol_id, callee_symbol_id, depth) AS (SELECT e.caller_symbol_id, e.callee_symbol_id, 1 FROM code.call_edges e WHERE e.calls_directly AND e.caller_file_id = 'httpx/_client.py' AND e.callee_file_id = 'httpx/_client.py' UNION ALL SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, e.callee_symbol_id, c.depth + 1 FROM chain c JOIN code.call_edges e ON e.caller_symbol_id = c.callee_symbol_id AND e.calls_directly AND e.caller_file_id = 'httpx/_client.py' AND e.callee_file_id = 'httpx/_client.py' WHERE c.depth < 50) SELECT DISTINCT c.caller_symbol_id AS symbol_id FROM chain c JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = c.callee_symbol_id WHERE s.name = '_send_single_request' AND s.qualname = 'Client._send_single_request' AND s.file_id = 'httpx/_client.py' AND c.caller_symbol_id <> s.symbol_id ORDER BY symbol_id
